projectName: Koala family new eyes, claws and nose
title: Koala family repaired, with new eyes, felt claws and a handmade nose
description: This koala family came in as three: big, medium and small. The big koala was missing an eye, so both of his eyes were replaced to match. The baby koala got new eyes, two new felt claws and a handmade nose.
itemDetails: This is a family of three plush koalas in big, medium and small sizes, with soft grey-brown fur, round fluffy ears, large dark noses and black claws on their paws.
repairDetails: Only the big and the small koala needed repairs. The medium koala was fine. The big koala had one eye missing, so both of his eyes were replaced so that they look the same. The baby koala was missing two of its four claws, so new claws were made from black felt. Its eyes were also missing and were replaced. Its nose was missing too, so a new one was made. The nose was shaped from clay, painted black and varnished, then a pin was attached and the nose was glued into place on the koala.
